hypothesis: Submission-11 video and the active controller both indicate excessive longitudinal deceleration when a recognized obstacle overlaps a high-sweep curve. Reducing only the supplemental curve-brake envelope in that registered compound state, while retaining the base distance/speed brake as a hard floor, should improve obstacle-corner carry without weakening the inherited high-overspeed safety brake, target speed, latch or steering.

scope.single_factor: Replace only the supplemental overspeed brake envelope in the existing target30 compound-obstacle state from clip(0.06 + 0.018*excess, 0.06, 0.28) to clip(0.04 + 0.012*excess, 0.04, 0.18), retaining the inherited base brake as a floor.

Do not weaken or remove the inherited base brake; it reaches0.28 at very high overspeed and is the safety floor for close or fast approaches.

Do not repeat the target30-to24 diagnostic, which was slower without fixing the seed21 failure.
static_acceptance: Only the brake component differs from control inside the registered compound gate; target, gas, steering and shared inherited state remain exact.
The candidate brake never exceeds control, never falls below the inherited base safety brake, remains finite/in bounds and never overlaps positive gas.
Current recognized compound obstacles and miss-latch frames1--4 are eligible; the fifth clearing frame, reacquired noncompound obstacle and all noncompound states remain control-exact.
Both turn directions and the sweep boundary immediately below/at6 receive symmetric, exact coverage.
The target-plus0.5 trigger and high-overspeed base-brake saturation boundaries remain exact.
Randomized differential coverage proves every difference is registered and brake-only.
Affected controller, inference, local-contract and submission suites pass.
An isolated package passes exact-file import, reset, finite-action, bounds and latency smoke without modifying root submission.zip.
rollback: Any action or shared-state difference outside the registered brake component and compound gate.
Any candidate brake below the inherited base safety brake or above the control brake.
Any target, gas, steering, detector, latch, state, reset, invalid-input, recovery, dependency, packaging, bounds, NaN or latency regression.

Rank valid finish first, then progress/collision/crash/off-track, minimum clearance and only then paired lap time.
future_environment_gate.safety_rollback: Reject on any new DNF, lower finish count, added collision/crash/off-track, materially lower minimum clearance or operational failure.
future_environment_gate.pace_gate: Only after safety non-regression, require lower paired lap time and faster compound-obstacle sectors.
